description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for testing rename and copy detection features in a version control system (probably Git). It sets up test environments, makes modifications, and compares expected diffs to actual diffs to verify correct detection of copies and renames within a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a shell command as a successful test case expectation, expecting the command to succeed (exit status 0).

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Runs a shell command and verifies that it exits with the specified exit code.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares the current diff output with the expected output stored in a file or variable.
